list.text: A dental clinic with 3 branches in Chilanzar, bookings on paper

heard.summary: A dental clinic with three branches in Chilanzar keeps bookings on paper and wants more control.
quotes: A dental clinic with 3 branches in Chilanzar

questions.text: Should patients prepay or pay online when booking?
How should patients get visit reminders?

solutions.title: Shared booking and patient records for three branches
solutions.why: Paper bookings across three branches make it hard to see free chairs, doctor schedules and patient history in one place. One clinic system gives the owner control over every branch and replaces the paper books.
solutions.difficulty_reason: Three branches, several staff roles and moving paper records into one system.

solutions.title: Patients book a dentist themselves in Telegram
solutions.why: Today every booking goes through the phone and paper, so patients booking free slots in Telegram takes load off the front desk. It reads the same schedule as the clinic system.
solutions.difficulty_reason: Must stay in sync with doctor schedules in all three branches.

solutions.title: Training front desk and doctors to drop paper
solutions.why: Staff used to paper and phone need short guides in Uzbek or Russian so the new system is actually used in every branch.
solutions.difficulty_reason: Simple work, but staff in three branches must change habits.

not_recommended.why: A separate mobile app is not needed yet, since a Telegram booking bot covers patient self-booking for three branches.
An AI call agent makes sense only after bookings live in one system and call volume is known.

pick.roadmap_note: Start with the clinic system in one branch, roll it out to all three, then add Telegram self-booking on top of the shared schedule.
pick.first_step: Collect one week of paper booking pages from each branch and list the doctors, chairs and services so the schedule can be set up.
assumptions: The clinic has no electronic booking or patient records today.
Each branch has its own front desk staff and doctors.
Telegram is the main channel patients use.

deliverables_mvp: On-site training sessions for front desk staff in each branch
Short session for doctors on the schedule and patient records
Quick-start guides in Uzbek and Russian for each daily task
Recorded video guides staff can rewatch on their phones
deliverables_full: Separate courses for front desk, doctors and branch admins
Short knowledge tests to check each person is ready
Knowledge base articles for common questions
Train-the-trainer sessions for one key user per branch
Follow-up session a month after launch

phases.deliverable: List of daily tasks per role and a training schedule for 3 branches
Quick-start guides and recorded videos in Uzbek and Russian
Trial session with one branch, guides corrected from feedback
Sessions in all branches and paper booking book retired

risks.text: Front desk staff keep a paper book alongside the system out of habit
risks.mitigation: Owner sets a date to stop paper; branch admins check the system daily

risks.text: Doctors are busy with patients and miss training sessions
risks.mitigation: Short sessions at quiet hours plus videos they can watch later

risks.text: Clinic system screens change before launch, making guides outdated
risks.mitigation: Record videos only after the clinic system passes testing

needs: The clinic management system ready and tested before training
A list of staff per branch with their roles
Time slots in each branch when staff can attend training
One responsible person per branch to answer questions after launch
A decision from the owner on the date paper bookings stop

impact.summary: Staff in all three branches use the new booking system the same way, so the owner gets a full and reliable picture instead of paper books.

deliverables_mvp: Telegram bot where patients pick a branch, dentist and free slot
Rescheduling and cancelling a visit inside the bot
Reminders to the patient a day and an hour before the visit
New bookings posted to each branch's front desk Telegram group
Admin panel for services, dentists and their schedules
deliverables_full: Prepayment for visits through Click or Payme
Review request after the visit and repeat check-up reminders
No-show statistics per branch and per dentist
Mini App interface with dentist photos and service lists

phases.deliverable: List of services, dentists and schedules for all three branches
Booking bot linked to the clinic system schedule, with reminders
Front desk staff book, move and cancel test visits in each branch
Bot link on signs, receipts and social pages in all branches

risks.text: Front desk keeps writing phone bookings on paper, so the bot offers slots already taken
risks.mitigation: All phone bookings go into the same schedule from launch day; paper is retired

risks.text: The clinic system schedule is not ready when the bot is built
risks.mitigation: Build the bot against the agreed schedule format and connect it once the system is live

risks.text: Older patients do not use the bot and keep calling
risks.mitigation: Keep phone booking and let staff send the bot link after each call

needs: Full list of services with typical visit length
Each dentist's working hours and branch
A Telegram account for the clinic and a group per branch front desk
One manager who approves schedules and bot texts
Texts for reminders and clinic rules in Uzbek and Russian

impact.summary: Patients book free slots themselves and get reminders, so fewer chairs stand empty and the front desk spends less time on the phone.

inputs.label: How many patients miss their visit each month across all branches?
What share of missed visits could reminders prevent?
What does an average visit cost the patient?
What share of a visit's price is your margin?

deliverables_mvp: Shared schedule of chairs and dentists across all three branches
Online booking for patients on the web and in Telegram
Patient records with visit notes from dental templates
Cashier screen with fiscal receipts for each visit
Telegram notices with a one-time link to results hosted in Uzbekistan
Owner reports on bookings and visits per branch and per dentist
deliverables_full: Medicine and dental materials stock per branch
Dentist pay calculated from the services they performed
Insurance and corporate client billing
Patient app and AI call reminders for appointments
Detailed analytics by dentist and by service

phases.deliverable: Map of branch schedules, staff roles and paper booking formats
Booking, patient records and cashier working for all three branches
One branch runs on the system in parallel with the paper book
All branches move off paper, with staff trained and records moved in

risks.text: Paper booking books and patient cards are incomplete or hard to read
risks.mitigation: Move only active patients and upcoming bookings first, add older cards as patients return

risks.text: Reception staff keep writing bookings on paper out of habit
risks.mitigation: Short training in each branch and the owner stops paper books on a fixed day

risks.text: Fiscal module setup for each branch till takes longer than planned
risks.mitigation: Start fiscal registration with the provider during the plan phase

needs: One decision maker who approves schedules, roles and screens
List of dentists, chairs, working hours and services with prices per branch
Current paper booking books and patient cards for moving data in
Fiscal module or online cash register details for each branch
A Telegram account for the clinic bot and a contact person per branch

impact.summary: Patients book themselves and get reminders in Telegram, so fewer chairs stand empty and the owner sees every branch in one place.

inputs.label: How many patients miss their appointment each month across all branches
What share of missed visits reminders could save
What an average dental visit brings in
What share of a visit's price is profit

list.text: A restaurant with delivery, orders by phone and Telegram

heard.summary: A single restaurant with delivery that takes orders by phone and Telegram and wants more sales.

questions.text: Do you use iiko or R-Keeper at the till?
Should customers pay online when they order?

solutions.title: Telegram ordering bot with menu and delivery pin
solutions.why: Customers already order through Telegram, so a bot with your menu, payment and a map pin takes orders without staff typing them up. Every order arrives complete in your kitchen group, which means fewer mistakes and more orders handled at busy times.
solutions.difficulty_reason: Standard bot flow; menu setup and delivery zones need care.

solutions.title: Cashback in Telegram to bring customers back
solutions.why: Once orders come through the bot, cashback gives regular customers a reason to order again instead of choosing another place. You also see who orders often and who stopped.
solutions.difficulty_reason: Simple cashback rules tied to the existing bot orders

solutions.title: Phone line that records calls and flags missed ones
solutions.why: Phone orders are lost when the line is busy; IP telephony routes calls to a free person and shows missed calls to call back.
solutions.difficulty_reason: Number transfer and setup with your phone provider

not_recommended.why: Your customers already use Telegram, so a separate app adds cost without bringing more orders yet.
With one location, courier and dispatcher apps are more than you need before order volume grows.

pick.roadmap_note: Start with the ordering bot, add cashback once orders flow through it, and look at the phone line after that.
pick.first_step: Prepare your current menu with prices and photos, and draw your delivery zones on a map.
assumptions: You run your own couriers rather than only aggregators.
Orders now arrive in a Telegram group that staff read by hand.
You have one kitchen and one delivery area.

deliverables_mvp: Customer sign-up in the bot with a phone number
Personal QR cashback card inside Telegram
Cashier or operator adds cashback by scanning the QR
Balance and order history visible to each customer
Broadcast messages to all members with offers
deliverables_full: Link to iiko, R-Keeper or 1C so cashback is added automatically
Levels, birthday offers and referral bonuses
Customer segments by how often they order
Report on results of each campaign
Loyalty card as a Telegram Mini App

phases.deliverable: Cashback rules, sign-up flow and broadcast texts agreed with you
Loyalty bot with QR card, balance and cashier scan screen
Staff trial on real orders, delivery and dine-in, with fixes
Bot live, existing Telegram customers invited, staff trained

risks.text: For delivery orders the cashier may forget to add cashback, so customers lose trust
risks.mitigation: Add cashback from the order bot by phone number and give staff a short checklist

risks.text: Cashback rate set too high eats into margin on delivery orders
risks.mitigation: Start with a modest rate and a minimum order, review after the first month

risks.text: Few customers join if the bot is not promoted
risks.mitigation: Mention it on every call, in the Telegram group and on delivery packaging

needs: Decision on cashback rate, minimum order and how points can be spent
A person who approves rules and broadcast texts
Telegram account for the bot and access to your current Telegram group
List of staff who will scan QR codes or add cashback
Logo and short welcome text for the bot

impact.summary: Regular customers get a reason to order again from you instead of another place, and you can bring back those who stopped ordering.

inputs.label: How many orders do you get a month?
What is the average order?
What share of an order is your margin?
How much could repeat orders grow?

deliverables_mvp: Cloud phone line on your existing number
Short voice menu in Uzbek and Russian
Calls ring the next free person when one is busy
Every call recorded, with a recorded notice to callers
Missed-call list sent to your Telegram group for call-back
deliverables_full: Operator screen that enters phone orders into iiko or R-Keeper
Live board of calls in progress and waiting
Call tracking by ad source
Reports per person on answered and missed calls

phases.deliverable: Call flow, menu texts and who answers at which hours
Cloud PBX, number transfer, queue and Telegram alerts set up
Test calls at busy hours, recordings and missed-call alerts checked
Number live, staff shown how to answer and call back

risks.text: Moving your current number to a SIP provider takes longer than planned
risks.mitigation: Start the transfer request on day one and forward calls from the old number meanwhile

risks.text: Staff ignore missed-call alerts during the dinner rush
risks.mitigation: Name one person per shift responsible for call-backs and show them the list

needs: Contract details and access for your current phone number
Decision on who answers calls on each shift
Texts for the voice menu, or approval of our draft
Your Telegram group where missed calls should go
Office internet and phones or headsets for staff

impact.summary: Fewer phone orders are lost to busy lines and unanswered calls, because each missed caller gets a call back.

inputs.label: How many delivery orders do you get by phone a month?
What share more orders could you get by calling back missed callers?
What is the average delivery order?
What share of an order is your margin?

deliverables_mvp: Menu bot with categories and photos in Uzbek and Russian
Cart with delivery or pickup choice
Address by map pin or shared location
Payment through Click and Payme
Every order posted complete to your kitchen Telegram group
Simple admin panel to edit dishes, prices and stop-lists
deliverables_full: Delivery zones on Yandex Maps with zone-based delivery fees
Order statuses sent to the customer as the order moves
Promo codes and courier assignment
Sales reports by dish, day and customer
Menu and prices synced from iiko, R-Keeper or 1C

phases.deliverable: Menu structure, delivery area rules and order flow agreed
Working bot with menu, cart, map pin and Click and Payme
Test orders and payments run with your kitchen staff
Bot live, announced to your current Telegram customers

risks.text: Click and Payme merchant approval takes longer than the build
risks.mitigation: Apply for merchant accounts in the first days; launch with cash on delivery if needed

risks.text: Menu photos and descriptions are not ready in both languages
risks.mitigation: Start with text-only dishes and add photos after launch

risks.text: Staff keep taking phone orders by hand and skip the bot
risks.mitigation: Agree one rule: phone orders are entered in the bot by the operator

needs: Full menu with prices, portions and photos in Uzbek and Russian
Click and Payme merchant accounts for your legal entity
Delivery area and delivery fee rules
A Telegram group for the kitchen and the person who accepts orders
One manager who decides on menu and order flow questions

impact.summary: Customers can order and pay at any time without waiting on the phone, so fewer orders are lost at busy hours.

inputs.label: How many delivery orders do you get a month?
What is the average order value?
What share of an order is your margin?
By how much could orders grow with the bot?

list.text: A learning centre with 200 students, payments in Excel

heard.summary: A single-branch learning centre with 200 students tracks payments in Excel and wants better control of them.

questions.text: Should parents be able to pay online with Click or Payme?
How should parents get payment reminders?

solutions.title: Student, group and payment system for your centre
solutions.why: Payments in Excel make it hard to see who has paid and who is overdue for 200 students. One system linking students, groups, attendance and payments shows debts at once and reminds parents automatically.
solutions.difficulty_reason: Moving existing Excel records and matching payments to students and groups.

not_recommended.why: A separate mobile app is not needed to fix payments; Telegram reminders reach parents already.
Online lessons do not address the payment tracking problem you described.

pick.roadmap_note: Start with students, groups and payments in one system, then add online payment and reminders once records are clean.
pick.first_step: Gather your current Excel payment files and the list of groups and prices so the data can be moved in.
assumptions: Lessons happen in person at one location.
Your Excel file holds student names, groups and payment history.

deliverables_mvp: Student and group records with timetable
Attendance marked from the teacher's phone
Payments, debts and overdue list per student
Parent Telegram bot for dues and missed lessons
Excel payment history moved into the system
Basic reports on payments and debts
deliverables_full: Teacher pay by hours or by students
Exam results and student progress tracking
Marketing source analytics for new leads
Homework and materials for students
Parent mobile app

phases.deliverable: Agreed list of groups, fees, discounts and debt rules
Working system with students, attendance, payments and parent bot
Imported Excel data checked against real balances with the admin
Staff trained, parents connected to the bot, Excel retired

risks.text: Excel records are inconsistent, so imported balances do not match what parents actually paid
risks.mitigation: Clean the file with the admin first and reconcile balances before launch

risks.text: Parents do not join the Telegram bot and reminders reach few of them
risks.mitigation: Admin shares a join link at enrolment and on payment day

risks.text: Teachers keep marking attendance on paper
risks.mitigation: Short training and a one-tap attendance screen

needs: Current Excel files with students, groups and payments
Price list, discounts and rules for overdue payments
List of teachers and groups with the timetable
A Telegram account for the centre's bot
One person who decides on rules and checks the data

impact.summary: The admin stops checking payments by hand in Excel, sees debts at once and parents get reminders without phone calls.

inputs.label: How many hours a week go to tracking payments and chasing debts by hand?
What does an hour of your admin's time cost?

list.text: A beauty salon, bookings through Instagram

heard.summary: A single beauty salon with 6 to 20 staff takes bookings through Instagram and wants more new customers.

questions.text: Do you want clients to prepay or leave a deposit when booking?
Are you listed on Yandex Maps, Google Maps or 2GIS?

solutions.title: Self-booking for salon clients in Telegram
solutions.why: Clients pick a stylist and a free slot themselves instead of waiting for an Instagram reply, and get reminders so fewer slots go empty. A link in your Instagram profile sends new followers straight to booking.
solutions.difficulty_reason: Standard booking flow; needs each stylist's schedule and services set up correctly.

solutions.title: Instant replies to Instagram enquiries
solutions.why: New customers who write in Instagram get prices and answers at once, at any hour, and are guided to book. Quick replies keep people who would otherwise go to another salon.
solutions.difficulty_reason: The AI must learn your services and prices and hand bookings to the calendar.

solutions.title: Collect and answer reviews on maps
solutions.why: People choosing a new salon look at map ratings first, so answering every review quickly brings in new customers.
solutions.difficulty_reason: Connecting map listings and setting alerts for one location is simple.

not_recommended.why: A single salon does not need its own app; a Telegram booking bot does the same job without clients installing anything.
With one location, the booking bot's client list is enough to start before a full CRM.

pick.roadmap_note: Start with the Telegram booking bot, then add the Instagram assistant that sends enquiries into it, and work on map reviews after that.
pick.first_step: Write down your services, prices, durations and each stylist's working hours so the booking bot can be set up.
assumptions: Clients already use Telegram widely, so booking there suits them.
Most new customers find you through Instagram today.
Payment stays at the salon unless you choose prepayment.

deliverables_mvp: Telegram bot listing your services, stylists and their schedules
Clients book, reschedule or cancel a free slot themselves
Reminders a day and an hour before the visit, with SMS backup
New bookings posted to your staff Telegram group
Admin panel to edit services, stylists and working hours
deliverables_full: Prepayment with Click or Payme to hold a slot
Review request after the visit and repeat-visit reminders
No-show statistics per stylist and service
Mini App interface with photos of work and prices

phases.deliverable: Agreed list of services, durations, prices and stylist schedules
Working booking bot with reminders, staff group and admin panel
Staff and a few regular clients book test slots for a week
Bot link in Instagram profile and stories, staff trained to use it

risks.text: Stylists keep taking bookings in Instagram direct, so the bot calendar shows false free slots
risks.mitigation: Agree that every booking goes into the bot; admins enter direct requests through the panel

risks.text: Service durations and stylist schedules change often and are not written down anywhere
risks.mitigation: Collect them in one table during planning and let the admin edit them in the panel

needs: List of services with duration and price for each stylist
Working hours and days off for every stylist
A person at the salon who manages bookings and the admin panel
A Telegram group for staff notifications
An SMS sender account (Eskiz or Play Mobile) for reminders

impact.summary: Clients book any time without waiting for a reply, and reminders mean fewer forgotten appointments and empty chairs.

inputs.label: How many clients miss their booking each month?
What share of those missed visits could reminders save?
What does an average visit cost the client?
What share of a visit's price is your margin?

deliverables_mvp: AI replies in Instagram Direct in Uzbek and Russian, day and night
Answers from your own list of services, prices and stylists
Short questions to learn which service and time the client wants
Hands the client to the Telegram booking bot to pick a free slot
Passes hard or unusual questions to the salon administrator
deliverables_full: Telegram and WhatsApp chats answered by the same assistant
Follow-up messages to people who asked but did not book
Suggestions of related services, such as a manicure with a haircut
Report on enquiries and bookings by channel

phases.deliverable: Agreed list of services, prices, tone and handover rules
Assistant connected to Instagram Direct and the booking bot
Real enquiry scenarios checked with the salon administrator
Assistant live on the salon account with daily review of chats

risks.text: Meta business account access or Instagram API approval takes longer than planned
risks.mitigation: Set up a Business account and Facebook page linked to it at the start

risks.text: Prices change often or depend on hair length, so the AI quotes wrong amounts
risks.mitigation: Quote price ranges and let the administrator confirm exact prices

needs: Instagram Business account linked to a Facebook page, with admin access
Full list of services with prices, durations and stylists
Answers to common questions: address, parking, payment, cancellations
One administrator who reviews chats and takes handed-over clients

impact.summary: Fewer new clients are lost to slow or missed replies in Instagram, so more enquiries turn into bookings.

inputs.label: How many bookings does the salon take a month?
How many more bookings could quick replies bring, in percent?
What is the average bill per visit?
What share of the bill is profit, in percent?

deliverables_mvp: Salon profiles checked and completed on Yandex Maps, Google Maps, 2GIS
All new reviews gathered into one Telegram feed for the salon
AI-drafted replies in Uzbek and Russian for the manager to approve
Post-visit feedback bot asking each client for a score and comment
Review links sent to every client after their visit
deliverables_full: Rating trends by topic such as service, prices and waiting time
Mentions of individual stylists and services in reviews
Monthly report on ratings and reply times
Link to a complaints desk for handling unhappy clients

phases.deliverable: List of map profiles, owners' access and the reply tone agreed
Telegram review feed, reply drafts and the feedback bot set up
Real reviews and test clients run through the feed and the bot
Manager trained, feedback bot sent to clients after visits

risks.text: Access to the salon's map profiles is lost or held by a former employee or agency
risks.mitigation: Start ownership recovery on each map service in the first days of the project

risks.text: Some map services offer no reply API, so replies cannot be posted automatically
risks.mitigation: Staff post the approved replies by hand from the Telegram feed

risks.text: Clients ignore the feedback request because bookings come through Instagram, not a bot
risks.mitigation: Admin sends the feedback link from the bot after each visit with the client's contact

needs: Owner access to the salon's Google, Yandex Maps and 2GIS profiles
Current photos, price list, hours and address for the profiles
A manager who approves AI reply drafts each day
A Telegram account or group for the review feed
Client phone or Telegram contact collected at booking for feedback requests

impact.summary: Better map ratings and quick replies to reviews make more people who find the salon on maps choose it and book.

inputs.label: How many client visits does the salon have a month?
By what share could new bookings grow from better reviews?
What does an average visit cost?
What share of a visit's price is profit?

list.text: City freight, 15 drivers, reports on paper

heard.summary: A city freight company with 15 drivers where trips and reports are kept on paper and by phone.
quotes: City freight, 15 drivers, reports on paper

questions.text: Do your trucks already have GPS trackers?
Where do you keep invoices and accounting?

solutions.title: Telegram trip reports from your 15 drivers
solutions.why: Drivers send delivery photos, location and notes from their phones instead of paper reports. You see every trip the same day without calling anyone.
solutions.difficulty_reason: Simple bot, but drivers must get used to reporting after each drop.

solutions.title: One system for orders, trucks and drivers
solutions.why: Once reports are digital, orders, assignments and documents can live in one place instead of on paper and phone calls. This gives you the control you asked for.
solutions.difficulty_reason: Moving a paper and phone workflow into a full order and fleet system.

not_recommended.why: Separate driver and dispatcher apps are more than 15 drivers need when a Telegram bot covers reporting.
Fuel and driving monitoring can wait until trip reporting and orders are under control.

pick.roadmap_note: Start with the Telegram report bot to get drivers off paper, then build the transport system on top of that data.
pick.first_step: Collect one week of your current paper trip reports so the bot's report form matches what you already track.
assumptions: All 15 drivers work from one base in one city.

deliverables_mvp: Trip report form in Telegram for each of your drivers
Delivery photo with time and location check
All reports land in one Google Sheet
Location pin on the map for each drop
Evening summary of the day's trips for the manager
deliverables_full: Required checklist and photos per trip type
Offline queue so reports send when coverage returns
Map of all drops per driver and day
Reports per driver showing trips and missed reports

phases.deliverable: Agreed trip report template and sheet layout with the dispatcher
Working bot with photo, location and Google Sheet export
Pilot with a few drivers on real city trips, fixes made
All drivers onboarded, paper reports stopped

risks.text: Some drivers skip reports or keep calling instead of using the bot
risks.mitigation: Short form, a reminder after each trip and a manager rule that only bot reports count

risks.text: Old phones or poor coverage make photos and location fail to send
risks.mitigation: Check drivers' phones in the pilot and compress photos before upload

needs: A sample of the current paper trip report
List of drivers with their Telegram accounts
A Google account for the report sheet
A dispatcher or manager who owns the rollout and approves the template

impact.summary: The dispatcher stops collecting paper and phoning drivers, and sees every trip in one table the same day.

inputs.label: How many hours a week go to collecting and checking driver reports by hand?
What does one hour of a dispatcher's or office worker's time cost you?

deliverables_mvp: Order register with quotes for each city delivery
List of your trucks and 15 drivers with their availability
Trip planning: assign orders to a truck and driver
Driver app with trip statuses and delivery photos
Waybills generated from the order instead of paper
Link to open a truck's GPS position when trackers exist
deliverables_full: Client portal where customers see their orders and documents
Expenses and fuel norms per trip
Profit per client and per route
E-invoices sent from the system

phases.deliverable: Map of how an order moves today from call to signed waybill
Order, truck, trip and waybill screens plus the driver app
A week of real trips run in the system alongside paper
Dispatchers and all drivers switched over, paper reports stopped

risks.text: Drivers keep calling and writing on paper instead of using the app
risks.mitigation: Keep the driver app to a few buttons and train drivers in person in their language

risks.text: Waybill formats and order rules differ from what dispatchers describe
risks.mitigation: Collect real filled waybills and sit with dispatchers during planning

risks.text: Drivers use old or cheap phones that struggle with the app
risks.mitigation: Check drivers' phones early and test the app on the weakest models

needs: Samples of current paper reports, waybills and order notes
List of trucks and drivers with their phone numbers
One dispatcher or manager who decides on workflow questions
Your company details for printed waybills
Decision on whether trucks have or will get GPS trackers

impact.summary: You see every order, truck and driver in one place and stop chasing trip details by phone and paper.

list.text: Wholesale building materials, we use 1C, dealers phone in orders

heard.summary: A building materials wholesaler on 1C whose dealers place orders by phone, and the owner wants more sales.

questions.text: Do you deliver orders with your own trucks?
Should dealers pay online when they order?

solutions.title: Dealer ordering in Telegram linked to your 1C
solutions.why: Dealers who now phone in orders can place them any time in Telegram with their own prices and balance, so no call is missed and managers stop retyping orders. Easier reordering helps dealers buy more often.
solutions.difficulty_reason: Dealer-specific prices, stock and balances must sync reliably with 1C.

solutions.title: Morning sales report per dealer from 1C
solutions.why: Once orders flow through the bot, you see which dealers buy more, less or stopped buying, so sales staff know whom to call.
solutions.difficulty_reason: Data already sits in 1C; the work is choosing the right few figures.

not_recommended.why: A separate mobile app is not needed while dealers can order in Telegram, which they already use.
You already run 1C, so connecting to it is enough instead of replacing it.

pick.roadmap_note: Start with the Telegram ordering bot on 1C data, then add the sales report once order history builds up.
pick.first_step: Export your dealer list with their price types from 1C and pick a few active dealers to test the bot.
assumptions: Each dealer has its own price type in 1C.
Staff of 21 to 100 was read as a medium business.

deliverables_mvp: Telegram Mini App catalogue of your building materials
Each dealer sees their own price list pulled from 1C
Minimum order quantities and stock shown per item
Dealer balance and credit limit visible before ordering
Orders go straight into 1C without retyping
Order notifications to dealers and your sales managers
deliverables_full: Reconciliation statements dealers can open in the bot
Promotions by dealer segment
Payment by Click, Payme or bank transfer with an invoice
E-invoices through Didox
Reports by agent and region

phases.deliverable: Map of 1C price lists, stock, balances and order flow for dealers
Mini App catalogue, dealer login and two-way 1C exchange
Pilot with a few dealers placing real orders into 1C
All dealers invited, managers trained, phone orders moved to the bot

risks.text: 1C configuration is customised or poorly structured, so prices and balances are hard to read
risks.mitigation: Review the 1C setup in the plan phase with your 1C specialist

risks.text: Dealers keep phoning out of habit and ignore the bot
risks.mitigation: Pilot with active dealers, managers send the bot link after every call

risks.text: Building material units differ (pallets, bags, tonnes), causing order mistakes
risks.mitigation: Agree units and pack sizes per item in 1C before the build

needs: Access to your 1C database and contact with your 1C specialist
List of dealers with their price types and credit limits
Product photos and short descriptions for the catalogue
A manager who decides on order rules and approves the pilot
A Telegram account for the company bot

impact.summary: Dealers can reorder at any hour without waiting for a manager, so fewer orders are lost and dealers buy more often.

inputs.label: How many dealer orders do you get a month?
